title: gentianella lutescens subsp. carpatica
intro: Gentianella lutescens subsp. carpatica, commonly known as Alpine Yellow Gentian, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the family Gentianaceae. This plant has been traditionally used in folk medicine for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help alleviate digestive issues, reduce fever, and support the immune system. The therapeutic actions of Gentianella lutescens subsp. carpatica are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including iridoids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are known for their ability to modulate various biological pathways and protect against oxidative stress. While further research is necessary to fully understand its effects, the plant's bioactive properties have been studied for their potential in treating various conditions, including infections and inflammation.
